presentation_grammar_confirmation.description: The Claude-first, G-adjudicated Cable One exemplar conforms to and reconfirms, without modification, BLUEPRINT.md Section 141's locked grammar: no generic PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY heading; default section order EDUCATION, SKILLS, WORK EXPERIENCE, RELEVANT PROJECT; single bold 'Title | Employer' work-entry line with right-aligned dates; two-school education grammar; three natural recruiter-facing skills rows; one page; one column; DOCX-first; real hyperlinks; 92%+ meaningful page utilization.

jd_to_evidence_crosswalk_requirement.description: Future tailoring must operate through verified JD -> canonical Requirement/EvidenceMatch state (BLUEPRINT.md Section 140.4) -> approved Candidate Truth/evidence -> package decision. Supported employer terminology may be used naturally when the crosswalk establishes overlap, while NONE or UNKNOWN tools/capabilities remain absent from candidate-facing text.

evidence_budget_allocation.description: The package must surface the strongest role-relevant supported evidence across summary, skills, bullet ordering, project selection, and page-space allocation without changing the underlying qualification result or hiding a material gap. The strongest current/relevant experience receives the most evidence space by default; secondary experiences and projects receive less, unless the JD crosswalk materially earns a different evidence budget.

coherent_narrative_requirement.description: The resume must read as one coherent human career story rather than disconnected keyword blocks: current career stage and education establish context, skills preview evidenced capability, work bullets prove applied capability, and project evidence supplies technical/analytical proof where relevant.

candidate_facing_translation_requirement.description: Candidate-facing language is ordinary direct American English; internal Career OS, governance, evidence-system, implementation-control, or AI-process terminology must be translated into recruiter-natural wording unless that terminology is itself genuinely job-relevant evidence.

bullet_and_quantification_discipline.description: Bullets prefer action plus context plus evidence-supported outcome/value; when no measured outcome exists, use action plus context or purpose without manufacturing impact, and normally keep bullets to one or two rendered lines where practical. Quantification is used only when approved evidence supports it and when it helps a recruiter understand scale, result, or complexity; no invented percentages, productivity estimates, derived annualized figures, or decorative metrics.
extends_not_replaces: BLUEPRINT.md Section 141.7 research-backed recruiter/ATS writing constraints

norma_resume_comparison_boundary.description: Norma_Resume is retained only as external comparison evidence supporting conventional one-column density, visible tools, action-led bullets, and substantial page use. It must never become a second Bora template or override Bora's own gold reference.

truth_fidelity.description: Every candidate-facing statement traces to approved Claim_ID/Evidence_ID lineage within its recorded boundaries (.cursor/rules/resume.mdc Claim Lineage); no invented fact, tool, metric, or outcome.

jd_evidence_coverage.description: The package is checked against the verified JD -> Requirement/EvidenceMatch crosswalk (BLUEPRINT.md Section 140.4) for truthful overlap; STRONG/SUPPORTED requirements are represented, PARTIAL stays within its transfer boundary, and NONE/UNKNOWN requirements remain visible gaps rather than being solved through wording.

human_naturalness.description: Candidate-facing wording reads as ordinary, concrete, direct American English written by a person, not as disconnected keyword blocks or internal-system jargon (see candidate_facing_translation_requirement and coherent_narrative_requirement above).

interview_defensibility.description: Every bullet and summary claim must be something Bora could truthfully explain and defend in a live interview without embellishment; no wording is permitted that a truthful follow-up question would contradict.

reference_conformance.description: The rendered package conforms to BLUEPRINT.md Section 141's locked presentation grammar (see presentation_grammar_confirmation above), not a freehand redesign.

rendered_one_page_quality.description: The rendered document is one U.S.-Letter page by default meeting BLUEPRINT.md Section 137's 92% meaningful-page-utilization floor, with no overflow, clipping, or overlap.

functional_hyperlinks.description: Human-readable link labels are backed by genuine hyperlink objects (a real DOCX hyperlink run, or a real URI annotation for PDF) and their destinations are verified before submission, per BLUEPRINT.md Section 140.5/140.6.

gate.description: Final package QA must test all seven dimensions above before Bora's human approval gate; this is a manual QA checklist, not an automated validator or generator.

claude_drafting_pilot_reaffirmed.description: Claude may draft candidate-facing wording only from the verified JD, the approved Requirement/EvidenceMatch crosswalk, approved Candidate Truth/evidence, and canonical gold grammar (BLUEPRINT.md Section 141.8, unchanged by this record). G must reject unsupported or less-natural language and remains responsible for final adjudication, document construction, render QA, and hyperlinks. This does not loosen the existing AI Boundaries in .cursor/rules/resume.mdc.

research_basis: Cable One first-party Business Analyst I posting: operational data analysis, trends, reporting models/KPIs, operational efficiency, cross-functional work, reconciliation, 1-2 years or equivalent education/experience, and advanced Excel/data management preferred
Yale Office of Career Strategy: simple readable one-page formatting, standard fonts, role-relevant action-led accomplishment bullets, and JD-aligned transferable skills
University of Pennsylvania Career Services: one-page consistent formatting, 1-2 line action-led bullets with context, transferable skills, and results/quantification where meaningful
U.S. Department of Labor VETS Resume Essentials 2026: targeted achievement statements, everyday language, action verbs, and job-posting skill alignment
Indeed 2026 ATS guidance: use job-description keywords naturally while writing for both ATS and human recruiters
Norma_Resume external comparison: conventional one-column structure, dense-but-readable page use, visible tools, and action-led evidence; comparison evidence only, never Bora template authority
